owner.mailing: 12352 S Nashville Ave, Palos Hts IL 60463

leads.probabilityBasis: 32.4% of 7,975 restaurant closures (2016–2025) were followed by a new food business license under a different name at the same address within a year, vs 3.1% after ordinary inspections (10.3x). Counting only licenses issued 31+ days after the closure: 15.1% vs 3.0% (5.1x), median 154 days, middle half 82–252 days; adjusted for the 7 days already passed. Renovation, build-out or new-construction permit within a year: 11.0% vs 6.2% (1.78x, a weak signal), also adjusted.

evidence.label: Renovation permits in the 2 years before

leads.action: Send a letter to the property owner's mailing address offering to prepare or build out the space for the next tenant; follow up at weeks 6, 12 and 24. Most later food licenses arrive 82–252 days after the closure (middle half of licenses issued 31+ days later).
